## prompt-2-draft-protocol

*Generated by Process A from the master prompt in
[`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting the
Phase I `trial-protocol` draft stage to the Phase II protocol. Runs in stage
`trial-phase-2/draft-protocol/`.*

Author the **Stage 2 draft protocol**: the first LaTeX paper files for the
*Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled* protocol, written as a scaffold of
bracketed `[DRAFTING INSTRUCTION]` blocks that identify the exact
`physical-ai-oncology-trials` files and directories each later stage consumes.

**Files (one commit each).** `main.tex` (cover, clickable table of contents, one
`\input` per NIH section), `protostyle.sty` (the recolored Phase II style:
Burgundy `#800020`, Charcoal `#2E2E2E`, Slate `#6B6B6B`, Mist `#C9C9C9`, Cloud
`#F5F5F5`), `references.bib` (the daraxonrasib group, the three main documents,
the Phase I predicate, directly relevant author works, clinical references, the
randomized-trial and reporting-method references, and the FDA / CFR / consensus
standards), and `README.md`. Then one commit per `sections/sec-00 .. sec-12`
scaffold file.

**Scaffold content.** Each `sections/sec-NN.tex` opens with its `\section{...}`
heading and the NIH subsection skeleton, then `\draftinstr{...}` blocks that name
the source files (for example `trial-protocol/nih-protocol/03_study_design...`,
`trial-protocol/inputs/21cfr312_adapt`, `trial-protocol/inputs/auto-bill-02`, the
Phase I `final-protocol/publication/sections/*`, and the `trial-phase-2/mermaid`
figures) and state what the full stage must render there, including which Mermaid
figure becomes which TikZ `mermaidfig` and which table is filled. Carry the table
of contents and the back matter. Bracketed instructions, not full prose.

**Locked Phase II design to scaffold (do not change later).** Multicenter (eight
high-volume academic HPB centers), randomized 1:1, parallel-group, controlled,
open-label with blinded independent central review; n = 220 (110 per arm);
primary endpoint progression-free survival (hazard ratio 0.60, 85 percent power,
two-sided alpha 0.05, about 140 events, one group-sequential interim); key
secondary hierarchy of overall survival, R0 rate, ISGPS grade B/C fistula,
major pathologic response, and ctDNA clearance; Arm A perioperative daraxonrasib
at the RP2D of 300 mg once daily plus the on-premises LLM-directed eight-arm
robotic Whipple, Arm B modified FOLFIRINOX plus standard pancreaticoduodenectomy;
the upgraded Phase 0 gate (USL greater than or equal to 8.0, at least 5000 sims,
at least 3 frameworks, sim-to-real less than 1.5 mm and less than 0.4 N); the
Patient-Aligned Co-Investment Facility behind a capital firewall.

**Commit schedule.** One commit per file, pushed in real time (10+ commits). The
second-to-last commit fixes all errors; the last commit writes the
`draft-protocol/README.md` and the `draft-protocol-LaTeX.zip` Overleaf bundle and
files `prompt-draft-protocol.md` (this prompt verbatim) and
`output-draft-protocol.md`. Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan mode.
The LaTeX must compile in Overleaf with pdfLaTeX.
